warnings: BOTH ENLARGEMENTS ARE TITLED แบบขยายหัวบันได, the same title twice at 1:10 and 1:2, and are two views of one newel post. Same treatment as the ราวบันได pair on this sheet.

THE NEWEL'S 1.15 m TOTAL HEIGHT IS MEASURED FROM THE TREAD IT STANDS ON, not from a floor level - the section on this sheet shows it starting at a step, not at +0.60. No level is printed on either enlargement, so none is recorded.

A-09 ALSO CARRIES A ราวบันได ENLARGEMENT AT 1:5 giving the handrail as ไม้แดง 2"x4" with a 0.05/0.10/0.05/0.04 profile. That is a third view of the same handrail at a third scale, on a different sheet. The three do not contradict - A-09 gives the handrail section, A-10 gives the balustrade elevation and the baluster profile - but anyone building the railing needs all three.
